title: filled next outline this page
rule: Standard (filled) for actions that go to a next step. Outline for actions that happen on the current page. Unstyled only for less important actions that may look like links.
pass_when: Next-step actions are filled; same-page actions are outline; unstyled is only for less important link-like actions.
fail_when: Filled used for a same-page action, outline used as the next-step control, or unstyled used as the primary next step.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Actions one-primary / distinctive-primary as this row.
